ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Anti-Fraud Push on Vulnerable Residents
ideas.description: Investigate how Minnesota's anti-fraud push is affecting vulnerable residents, including those on public assistance programs.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records to assess the impact on vulnerable populations.
questions: What are the specific impacts on vulnerable residents?
How effective is the anti-fraud push?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential issues with the state's approach to combating fraud and its effects on those who need assistance the most.
